title: Malicious code in @c1-ease/card (npm)
description: The npm package @c1-ease/card is a malicious dependency confusion shim that exports a no-op Proxy and includes a postinstall and require-time beacon. This beacon collects host identifiers and sends them unprotected to a hardcoded third-party server with disabled TLS validation, enabling data exfiltration. The package has no legitimate functionality and is designed to be a stealthy exfiltration vector in supply chain attacks.
